reproduction: Summarization algorithm (PR #734 review T6, 2026-09-01): GET /api/minio/objects (no prefix) returns the full object list; total_object_count = items.length; top-level folder = first path segment of each object key; distinct_top_level_folders = unique folder count; per-folder object_count = keys under that folder; extensions = unique lowercased file extensions of keys in the folder; roles: a key matching the coordinator source-IFC pattern (top-level-folder/<name>.ifc with sibling schedule/csv per bim-review-coordinator ifc-sources rules) counts as source_ifc, everything else other; has_source_ifc_pattern = folder contains at least one source_ifc key; folders_matching_source_ifc_pattern = count of such folders. Raw key listing and per-value digests are intentionally NOT retained per owner ruling Q1a and the standing public-repo privacy rule; independent reproduction requires bucket read access on the deployment, which the owner holds.
